solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Strange vice and unknown perversion

indicators.note: strange suggests the letters of vice and are put into an odd new order

parts.note: Y is one of the letters used for an unknown quantity in algebra

explanation.surface: A moralist frowns on some odd vice and an unnamed perversion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strange' rearranges VICEAND to DEVIANC; Y for 'unknown' goes on the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words name behaviour that departs from accepted norms, especially sexual ones; they are near synonyms.

clue.text: It sounds like woman getting married will show indignation

indicators.note: the clue says outright that what follows is said aloud and matched by ear

parts.note: a woman getting married is a bride, and things belonging to her are bridal

explanation.surface: A bride on her wedding day is about to take offence at something.
explanation.walkthrough: The spoken word is BRIDAL, 'of a bride', the nearest the clue comes to the woman getting married.
explanation.definitionFit: To bridle is to draw up stiffly in resentment, like a horse checked by its rein, so it means taking offence.

clue.text: Ceremonial march around island, a heavenly place

indicators.note: around says the march word is wrapped about the island letters

parts.note: a parade is a ceremonial procession or march

explanation.surface: A grand procession circles an island that is a kind of heaven on earth.
explanation.definitionFit: Paradise is the Christian and Islamic name for heaven, or any blissful spot.

clue.text: Top-class brewed hops

indicators.note: brewing works ingredients over, so the letters of hops are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: A beer made from the finest hops is described as top quality.
explanation.definitionFit: Posh is informal British for smart, upmarket or upper-class.

clue.text: Harvest orchard fruit that's to be seen again

parts.note: to harvest a crop is to reap it
a pear is a fruit grown in orchards

explanation.surface: A farmer picks orchard fruit that will grow back next season.
explanation.definitionFit: To reappear is to come back into view, to be visible once more.

clue.text: Abandon desolate area

definitions.meaning: to abandon someone is to leave them in the lurch
a barren, dry region with little life, like the Sahara

explanation.surface: Someone is urged to leave a bleak, empty landscape.
explanation.definitionFit: Desert is both the verb to forsake and the noun for an arid wasteland.

clue.text: Small cat producing air pollution

parts.note: S is the standard abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
MOG is British slang for a cat, especially an ordinary moggy

explanation.surface: A little cat somehow manages to cause pollution.
explanation.walkthrough: MOG (or moggy) is everyday British slang for a pet cat of no particular breed.
explanation.definitionFit: Smog is a blend of smoke and fog, a familiar kind of urban pollution in the air.

clue.text: Eccentric person needing low dam to perform

parts.note: a weir is a low dam across a river
to do a play or a trick is to perform it

explanation.surface: An odd character needs a little river dam in order to put on a show.
explanation.definitionFit: A weirdo is an informal word for a strange or oddball individual.

clue.text: Son dozes before exciting photo

parts.note: S is the standard abbreviation for son, as in family trees
naps are short sleeps or dozes
hot can mean thrilling or exciting, as in a hot ticket

explanation.surface: A boy nods off just before someone takes a thrilling picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A snapshot is an informal photograph taken quickly.

clue.text: Brain's minimum diameter

definitions.note: read as brain is, the apostrophe-s being a link to the wordplay

parts.note: D is the symbol used for diameter in geometry

explanation.surface: A medical note records the smallest width measured across a brain.
explanation.definitionFit: The mind is the thinking faculty, loosely used as a synonym for the intellect or grey matter.

clue.text: Personal assistant with right standard

explanation.surface: An office aide comes with the correct level of competence.
explanation.definitionFit: Par is the normal or expected level, as in up to par or par for the course.

clue.text: Flat accommodation for one letter?

parts.note: it reads like a flat let to a single tenant, but it is a thin paper holder that houses a single letter

explanation.surface: A property advert for a small flat suitable for a single occupant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flat' and 'accommodation' suggest housing, while 'letter' hints at a lodger who lets; really the letter is mail sitting in a flat paper case.
explanation.definitionFit: A cryptic description: a postal wrapper is a flat paper sleeve that holds a piece of correspondence.

clue.text: Son tossing tricycle out in protest

indicators.note: tossing throws the opening letter of son to the back of it

parts.note: taken as written
a trike is the informal word for a tricycle

explanation.surface: A boy throwing his tricycle out of the pram in a tantrum of protest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tossing' looks like throwing the tricycle away, but it throws the first letter of 'Son' to the back of that word.
explanation.definitionFit: Workers on strike have walked out to protest, so they are out in industrial action.

clue.text: Regular slices of steak, chop or Mexican food

indicators.note: regular slices take every other letter from the words steak and chop

explanation.surface: A menu offers neat portions of steak or chops, or a Mexican dish.
explanation.definitionFit: A taco is a folded corn tortilla with a filling, a staple Mexican snack.

clue.text: Ham's scent almost spoiled piece of game

indicators.note: spoiled suggests the letters are ruined and jumbled into a new order
almost means the last letter of scent is not used

explanation.surface: The smell of a ham has gone off, like a bit of game meat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' drops the T of scent to leave SCEN; 'spoiled' then rearranges HAMS plus SCEN.
explanation.definitionFit: A chessman is one of the pieces used in chess, which is the game meant here.

clue.text: Vigorously promote optimism, with young primarily replacing old

indicators.note: replacing says one letter is put in the place of another in the optimism word

parts.note: hope is a feeling of optimism

indicators.note: primarily means only the opening letter of young is used

explanation.surface: A campaign pushes optimism hard, with the young taking over from the old.
explanation.walkthrough: 'replacing' swaps the O (old) of HOPE for Y, the first letter of 'young', picked by 'primarily'.
explanation.definitionFit: To hype something is to publicise it with exaggerated enthusiasm.

clue.text: Motor spirit in European North-east

indicators.note: in says the spirit goes inside the other letters

parts.note: NE is the compass abbreviation for north-east
gin is a spirit, a strong alcoholic drink

explanation.surface: A motor runs on fuel somewhere in north-east Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: GIN goes between the E and the N.
explanation.definitionFit: An engine is a machine that converts fuel into motion, which is what a motor is.

clue.text: Gear to go very fast after 60 per cent reduction of speed

indicators.note: after places the very fast word behind the cut-down speed
cutting sixty per cent of a five-letter word removes three letters, so only its opening two remain

parts.note: to rocket is to shoot upward or move very fast

explanation.surface: A vehicle races off once its speed has been sharply cut.
explanation.walkthrough: Sixty per cent of five letters is three, so 'speed' keeps only its first two letters; 'Gear' looks like car gears but means a toothed wheel.
explanation.definitionFit: A sprocket is a toothed wheel engaging a chain, a kind of gear.

clue.text: Western character to overawe and wow!

parts.note: to cow someone is to intimidate or overawe them
boy! is an exclamation of surprise, like wow!

explanation.surface: A Western film character sets out to impress and amaze.
explanation.definitionFit: A cowboy is the stock hero of the Western film genre.

clue.text: Possible snack for a vegan fanatic

definitions.meaning: an almond or cashew, say, is a plant-based snack
an obsessive enthusiast, as in a fitness freak

explanation.surface: Something a vegan might nibble, or a zealot for the cause.
explanation.definitionFit: Nut means both a kernel eaten as food and, informally, a zealous enthusiast.

clue.text: Some find amnesia a mild curse

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some people who suffer memory loss find it a bit of a curse.
explanation.definitionFit: Damn is a common, fairly gentle swear word or oath.

clue.text: Endless story beginning to kill conversation

indicators.note: endless means the final letter of the story word is dropped

parts.note: a tale is a story

indicators.note: beginning to means only the opening letter of kill is used

explanation.surface: An interminable story starts to put an end to any chat.
explanation.definitionFit: Talk is spoken exchange between people, a synonym for chat.

clue.text: Wife lives with hot desire

parts.note: is can mean exists or lives, as in there is life
H stands for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: A wife lives in a state of burning passion.
explanation.definitionFit: A wish is a longing or desire for something.

clue.text: Church with barium compound used in glass

parts.note: BA is the chemical symbol for barium
silica, silicon dioxide, is the main ingredient of glass

explanation.surface: A church built with chemicals that make its glass windows.
explanation.definitionFit: A basilica is a large oblong church, or one given special status by the Pope.

clue.text: Husband, an idiot, turning over scrubber in bath

indicators.note: turning over says the combined letters are read backwards

parts.note: a fool is an idiot

explanation.surface: A foolish husband rolls over while scrubbing himself in the tub.
explanation.definitionFit: A loofah is the dried fibrous gourd used as a bath sponge for scrubbing skin.

clue.text: Annoying person on a bender, reacting without thinking

indicators.note: in an across answer on means sitting after, so the annoying person goes behind the bender

parts.note: the knee is a joint that bends, so it is jokingly a bender
a jerk is a contemptible or annoying person

explanation.surface: An irritating man out on a drinking binge reacts on impulse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on a bender' looks like a drinking spree, but 'bender' is the knee; in an across answer 'on' puts JERK after it.
explanation.definitionFit: A knee-jerk response is automatic, like the reflex kick when the knee is tapped.
